en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a vintage electric tram with two cars turning along curved tracks on a cobblestoned street in an old European town. People walk along the sidewalks, a bicycle leans near the curb, and a kiosk or small shop stands on the right. Buildings are two to three stories high with simple facades and double‑hung windows, giving a mid‑20th‑century Central/Eastern European atmosphere. The license or route plate on the tram and the kiosk sign appear to use a Central European script.
